source_filename: 爆款选题入库转逐字稿 副本_子牧_表格 (1).csv
id_convention: Z001 = first data row after CSV header; CSV record ordinal = ID number + 1; not physical line numbers
evidence_type: User supplied unverified transcripts; no video, dates, links or performance fields in the schema. URLs may occur inside titles.

reading_scope.all_records: Indexed; transcript heads and tails reviewed; exact-substring statistics computed over complete raw texts.

exclusion_reason: Z036 is a 13195-character annual retrospective with conversational repetition; excluded only from short-form-oriented statistics, retained in corpus and all-record statistics. Remaining records are not a pure genre classification.

related_records.note: Compilation and installments overlap by topic and text; not independent samples.

limitations: Not a representative random sample of the entire account.
Transcription errors and possible inserted dialogue remain unchanged.
Phrase prevalence is not distinctiveness against other creators or proof of performance.
CSV order does not establish publication chronology.
